```python
import itertools

NAMES = ["Peter", "Arnold", "Eric", "Carol", "Alice", "Bob"]
MUSIC = ["country", "classical", "pop", "hip hop", "jazz", "rock"]
STYLES = ["modern", "mediterranean", "victorian", "craftsman", "ranch", "colonial"]
PHONES = ["huawei p50", "iphone 13", "google pixel 6", "oneplus 9", "xiaomi mi 11", "samsung galaxy s21"]
PETS = ["hamster", "dog", "cat", "rabbit", "fish", "bird"]

def names_ok(p):
    if p[1] != "Peter":
        return False
    if abs(p.index("Carol") - p.index("Peter")) != 1:
        return False
    if abs(p.index("Carol") - p.index("Alice")) != 3:
        return False
    return True

def styles_ok(p, name):
    if p[name.index("Arnold")] != "victorian":
        return False
    if p[name.index("Carol")] != "craftsman":
        return False
    if p[name.index("Peter")] != "colonial":
        return False
    if p[name.index("Eric")] != "modern":
        return False
    return True

def music_ok(p, style):
    if p[style.index("colonial")] != "rock":
        return False
    if not (p.index("pop") < style.index("colonial")):
        return False
    if not (style.index("ranch") < p.index("classical")):
        return False
    return True

def phones_ok(p, name, style, music):
    if p[name.index("Peter")] != "oneplus 9":
        return False
    if p[style.index("modern")] != "samsung galaxy s21":
        return False
    if music[p.index("samsung galaxy s21")] != "hip hop":
        return False
    if p.index("google pixel 6") + 1 != p.index("xiaomi mi 11"):
        return False
    if abs(p.index("huawei p50") - music.index("country")) != 1:
        return False
    return True

def pets_ok(p, style, phone):
    if p[5] != "rabbit":
        return False
    if p[4] != "dog":
        return False
    if p.index("hamster") == 0:
        return False
    if p.index("cat") == 3:
        return False
    if p.index("cat") != style.index("mediterranean"):
        return False
    if p.index("bird") != phone.index("google pixel 6"):
        return False
    return True

def main():
    for name in itertools.permutations(NAMES):
        if not names_ok(name):
            continue
        for style in itertools.permutations(STYLES):
            if not styles_ok(style, name):
                continue
            for music in itertools.permutations(MUSIC):
                if not music_ok(music, style):
                    continue
                for phone in itertools.permutations(PHONES):
                    if not phones_ok(phone, name, style, music):
                        continue
                    for pet in itertools.permutations(PETS):
                        if pets_ok(pet, style, phone):
                            for h in range(6):
                                print(f"House {h+1}: {name[h]}, {music[h]}, {style[h]}, {phone[h]}, {pet[h]}")
                            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
def not_fix(var, h):
```

fix(...)

       arcs.append((x,y,eq)); arcs.append((y,x,eq))
...
arcs_in = {var: [] for var in domains}
for x,y,rel in arcs:
    arcs_in[y].append((x,y,rel))
degree = {var: len(arcs_in[var]) for var in domains}

def revise(x,y,rel,doms):
    dx = doms[x]
    dy = doms[y]
    if not dx or not dy:
        return False
    new_dx = set()
    for a in dx:
        for b in dy:
            if rel(a,b):
                new_dx.add(a)
                break
    if len(new_dx) != len(dx):
        doms[x] = new_dx
        return True
    return False

def ac3(doms):
    queue = deque(arcs)
    while queue:
        x,y,rel = queue.popleft()
        if not doms[x] or not doms[y]:
            return False
        if revise(x,y,rel,doms):
            if not doms[x]:
                return False
            for z, x2, rel2 in arcs_in[x]:
                queue.append((z, x2, rel2))
    return True

initial = {var: set(d) for var,d in domains.items()}
if not ac3(initial):

def search(doms):
    best = None
    best_len = H + 1
    best_deg = -1
    for var, d in doms.items():
        if len(d) > 1:
            deg = degree.get(var, 0)
            if len(d) < best_len or (len(d) == best_len and deg > best_deg):
                best = var
                best_len = len(d)
                best_deg = deg
    if best is None:
        for x,y,rel in arcs:
            if not rel(next(iter(doms[x])), next(iter(doms[y]))):
                return None
        return doms
    for val in sorted(doms[best]):
        new = {k: set(v) for k,v in doms.items()}
        new[best] = {val}
        if ac3(new):
            res = search(new)
            if res is not None:
                return res
    return None

def relation_holds(rel, x, y):
 if rel == 'lt': return x < y
 if rel == 'gt': return x > y
 if rel == 'direct_left': return x + 1 == y
 if rel == 'next': return abs(x-y)==1
 if rel == 'distance2': return abs(x-y)==2

def propagate(domains):
 changed = True
 while changed:
   changed=False
   # equality
   for a,b in equality_pairs:
      inter = domains[a] & domains[b]
      if not inter: return False
      if inter != domains[a]: domains[a]=inter; changed=True
      if inter != domains[b]: domains[b]=inter; changed=True
   # relational AC
   for rel,a,b in rel_constraints:
      da = domains[a]; db = domains[b]
      if not da or not db: return False
      new_da = {x for x in da if any(relation_holds(rel,x,y) for y in db)}
      new_db = {y for y in db if any(relation_holds(rel,x,y) for x in da)}
      if new_da != da:
         domains[a]=new_da; changed=True
         if not new_da: return False
      if new_db != db:

from collections import deque
def ac3(domains):
    queue = deque(arcs)  # all arcs
    while queue:
        x,y,pred = queue.popleft()
        if revise(x,y,pred,domains):
            if not domains[x]: return False
            for z,pred_zx in arcs_in[x]:
                if z != y:
                    queue.append((z,x,pred_zx))
    return True

def main():

```python
        "lunch": ["spaghetti", "soup", "grilled cheese", "stir fry", "stew", "pizza"],

        "mother": ["Holly", "Penny", "Aniya", "Kailyn", "Sarah", "Janelle"],
        "style": ["colonial", "craftsman", "modern", "ranch", "victorian", "mediterranean"],

    var_list = [(cat, val) for cat in categories for val in values[cat]]
    var_set = set(var_list)

    domains = {v: set(range(1, 7)) for v in var_list}
    domains[("name", "Carol")] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
    domains[("lunch", "spaghetti")] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6}

    arcs = []
    def add_constraint(a, b, pred):
        arcs.append((a, b, pred))
        arcs.append((b, a, lambda x, y, p=pred: p(y, x)))

    for cat in categories:
        vals = values[cat]
        for i in range(len(vals)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(vals)):
                add_constraint((cat, vals[i]), (cat, vals[j]), lambda x, y: x != y)

    add_constraint(("name", "Peter"), ("color", "green"), lambda x, y: x == y)

    add_constraint(("color", "blue"), ("mother", "Penny"), lambda x, y: x == y)

    add_constraint(("mother", "Holly"), ("name", "Alice"), lambda x, y: x + 1 == y)
    add_constraint(("mother", "Holly"), ("lunch", "stew"), lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 1)

    add_constraint(("lunch", "soup"), ("name", "Peter"), lambda x, y: x == y)
    add_constraint(("lunch", "pizza"), ("mother", "Sarah"), lambda x, y: x < y)
    add_constraint(("style", "victorian"), ("lunch", "grilled cheese"), lambda x, y: x == y)
    add_constraint(("lunch", "grilled cheese"), ("mother", "Aniya"), lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 3)
    add_constraint(("name", "Arnold"), ("color", "red"), lambda x, y: x == y)
    add_constraint(("style", "modern"), ("name", "Arnold"), lambda x, y: x == y)
    add_constraint(("color", "yellow"), ("style", "mediterranean"), lambda x, y: x == y)

    arcs_in = {v: [] for v in var_list}

    degree = {v: len(arcs_in[v]) for v in var_list}
```

```python
import itertools

NAMES = ["Alice", "Peter", "Arnold", "Bob", "Carol", "Eric"]
HAIRS = ["red", "brown", "blonde", "black", "gray", "auburn"]
OCCUPATIONS = ["engineer", "lawyer", "nurse", "doctor", "artist", "teacher"]

def positions(perm):
    return {value: index for index, value in enumerate(perm)}

def satisfies(name_pos, hair_pos, occ_pos):
    if hair_pos["brown"] == 1:
        return False
    if name_pos["Alice"] == 3:
        return False
    if occ_pos["artist"] != name_pos["Bob"]:
        return False
    if hair_pos["gray"] != occ_pos["doctor"]:
        return False
    if hair_pos["auburn"] != name_pos["Bob"]:
        return False
    if abs(occ_pos["doctor"] - name_pos["Bob"]) != 1:
        return False
    if occ_pos["engineer"] != name_pos["Alice"] - 1:
        return False
    if name_pos["Arnold"] != occ_pos["lawyer"] - 1:
        return False
    if name_pos["Bob"] + 1 != occ_pos["teacher"]:
        return False
    if not name_pos["Peter"] > hair_pos["brown"]:
        return False
    if name_pos["Arnold"] == 1:
        return False
    if hair_pos["black"] != name_pos["Arnold"]:
        return False
    if not occ_pos["doctor"] > hair_pos["red"]:
        return False
    if abs(hair_pos["brown"] - name_pos["Carol"]) != 1:
        return False
    if not name_pos["Arnold"] < occ_pos["doctor"]:
        return False
    return True

name_assignments = [(perm, positions(perm)) for perm in itertools.permutations(NAMES)]
hair_assignments = [(perm, positions(perm)) for perm in itertools.permutations(HAIRS)]
occupation_assignments = [(perm, positions(perm)) for perm in itertools.permutations(OCCUPATIONS)]

for name_perm, name_pos in name_assignments:
    if name_pos["Alice"] == 3 or name_pos["Arnold"] == 1:
        continue
    for hair_perm, hair_pos in hair_assignments:
        if hair_pos["brown"] == 1:
            continue
        if hair_pos["auburn"] != name_pos["Bob"] or hair_pos["black"] != name_pos["Arnold"]:
            continue
        if not name_pos["Peter"] > hair_pos["brown"]:
            continue
        if abs(hair_pos["brown"] - name_pos["Carol"]) != 1:
            continue
        for occ_perm, occ_pos in occupation_assignments:
            if satisfies(name_pos, hair_pos, occ_pos):
                for house in range(1, 7):
                    print(f"House {house}: {name_perm[house - 1]}, {hair_perm[house - 1]}, {occ_perm[house - 1]}")
                raise SystemExit
```

            else:
                for x in domains[other]:
                    if pred(x,val): newd.add(x)
            if not newd: return False
            domains[other] = newd
    return True

def propagate(assignment, domains):

        # empty check

        assigned_singletons = False
        for v in all_vars:

def propagate(domains):
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        # unary
        for (var, const, op) in unary_constraints:
            if op == 'eq':
                if const not in domains[var]: return None
                if len(domains[var]) > 1:
                    domains[var] = {const}; changed=True
            else: # ne
                if const in domains[var]:
                    domains[var] = domains[var] - {const}; changed=True
                    if not domains[var]: return None
        # binary AC
        for (x,y,rel) in binary_constraints:
            dx = domains[x]; dy = domains[y]
            # filter x
            new_dx = set()
            # optimization: if rel eq, new_dx = dx & dy
            # general loop small
            for xv in dx:
                if any(rel_func(xv, yv) for yv in dy):
                    new_dx.add(xv)
            # filter y
            new_dy = set()
            for yv in dy:
                if any(rel_func(xv, yv) for xv in dx):
                    new_dy.add(yv)
            if new_dx != dx:
                domains[x] = new_dx; changed=True; if empty return None
            if new_dy != dy:
                domains[y] = new_dy; changed=True; if empty return None
        # all-diff per category
        for cat in cats:
            vars = cat_vars[cat]
            # value support count
            for h in range(6):
                supporters = [v for v in vars if h in domains[v]]
                if len(supporters) == 0:
                    return None
                if len(supporters) == 1:
                    v = supporters[0]
                    if len(domains[v]) > 1:
                        domains[v] = {h}; changed=True
            # after possible assignments, remove singleton values from others
            for v in vars:
                if len(domains[v]) == 1:
                    h = next(iter(domains[v]))
                    for u in vars:
                        if u != v and h in domains[u]:
                            domains[u] = domains[u] - {h}; changed=True
                            if not domains[u]: return None
    return domains

    def propagate(domains):
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            # unary
            for var, const, op in unary:
                dom = domains[var]
                if op == 'eq':
                    if const not in dom:
                        return None
                    if len(dom) != 1:
                        domains[var] = {const}
                        changed = True
                else:
                    if const in dom:
                        new = dom - {const}
                        if not new:
                            return None
                        domains[var] = new
                        changed = True
            # binary
            for x, y, rel in binary:
                dx = domains[x]
                dy = domains[y]
                if not dx or not dy:
                    return None
                new_dx = set()
                # local variables for speed
                for xv in dx:
                    for yv in dy:
                        if rel(xv, yv):
                            new_dx.add(xv)
                            break
                if new_dx != dx:
                    if not new_dx:
                        return None
                    domains[x] = new_dx
                    changed = True
                    dx = new_dx
                new_dy = set()
                for yv in dy:
                    for xv in dx:
                        if rel(xv, yv):
                            new_dy.add(yv)
                            break
                if new_dy != dy:
                    if not new_dy:
                        return None
                    domains[y] = new_dy
                    changed = True
            # all-diff
            for cat in cats:
                vars = cat_vars[cat]
                # check each house has at least one supporter
                for h in range(6):
                    supporters = []
                    for v in vars:
                        if h in domains[v]:
                            supporters.append(v)
                    if len(supporters) == 0:
                        return None
                    if len(supporters) == 1:
                        v = supporters[0]
                        if len(domains[v]) != 1:
                            domains[v] = {h}
                            changed = True
                # singleton removal
                for v in vars:
                    if len(domains[v]) == 1:
                        h = next(iter(domains[v]))
                        for u in vars:
                            if u != v and h in domains[u]:
                                new = domains[u] - {h}
                                if not new:
                                    return None
                                domains[u] = new
                                changed = True
        return domains

```python
    domains[("name", "Alice")] = {0, 1, 2, 3}
    domains[("name", "Arnold")] = {0, 1, 2, 3}
```

    domains[("animal", "dog")] = {0, 1, 2, 3}
    domains[("vacation", "beach")] = {2}

    def equal(a, b):
        return a == b

    def two_between(a, b):
        return abs(a - b) == 3

    def next_to(a, b):
        return abs(a - b) == 1

    def left_of(a, b):
        return a < b

    constraints = [
        (("phone", "oneplus 9"), ("vacation", "mountain"), equal),
        (("name", "Bob"), ("vacation", "beach"), equal),
        (("animal", "fish"), ("name", "Alice"), equal),
        (("vacation", "camping"), ("animal", "horse"), equal),
        (("vacation", "city"), ("phone", "huawei p50"), equal),
        (("phone", "google pixel 6"), ("animal", "fish"), two_between),
        (("animal", "fish"), ("vacation", "mountain"), next_to),
        (("name", "Arnold"), ("phone", "samsung galaxy s21"), two_between),
        (("name", "Eric"), ("vacation", "mountain"), left_of),
    ]

    assignment = {}
    used = {cat: set() for cat in categories}

    def candidates(var):
        cat, _ = var
        possible = domains[var] - used[cat]
        for v1, v2, pred in constraints:
            if var == v1 and v2 in assignment:
                p2 = assignment[v2]
                possible = {p1 for p1 in possible if pred(p1, p2)}
            elif var == v2 and v1 in assignment:
                p1 = assignment[v1]
                possible = {p2 for p2 in possible if pred(p1, p2)}
        return possible

    def still_consistent():
        for v1, v2, pred in constraints:
            if v1 in assignment and v2 in assignment:
                if not pred(assignment[v1], assignment[v2]):
                    return False
        return True

    def solve():
        if len(assignment) == len(variables):
            return True

        best_var = None
        best_cands = None
        for var in variables:
            if var not in assignment:
                cands = candidates(var)
                if not cands:
                    return False
                if best_cands is None or len(cands) < len(best_cands):
                    best_var = var
                    best_cands = cands
                    if len(best_cands) == 1:
                        break

        if best_var is None:
            return False

        for pos in sorted(best_cands):
            cat, _ = best_var
            assignment[best_var] = pos
            used[cat].add(pos)

            if still_consistent() and solve():
                return True

            del assignment[best_var]
            used[cat].remove(pos)

        return False

    if solve():
        house_attrs = {cat: [None] * 5 for cat in categories}
        for (cat, value), pos in assignment.items():
            house_attrs[cat][pos] = value

        for i in range(5):

```python
from collections import deque

def main():
    houses = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    categories = {
        "name": ["Bob", "Arnold", "Alice", "Eric", "Peter"],
        "lunch": ["stew", "spaghetti", "grilled cheese", "pizza", "stir fry"],
        "color": ["green", "blue", "yellow", "red", "white"],
        "nationality": ["swede", "brit", "dane", "german", "norwegian"],
        "book": ["fantasy", "biography", "romance", "mystery", "science fiction"],
        "child": ["Timothy", "Samantha", "Meredith", "Fred", "Bella"],
    }
    output_order = ["name", "lunch", "color", "nationality", "book", "child"]

    domains = {}
    for cat, values in categories.items():
        for value in values:
            domains[(cat, value)] = set(houses)

    domains[("name", "Arnold")] = {3}
    domains[("color", "white")].discard(4)
    domains[("book", "romance")].discard(3)
    domains[("child", "Fred")].discard(3)

    constraints = [
        (("nationality", "swede"), ("child", "Bella"), "eq"),
        (("book", "science fiction"), ("lunch", "stew"), "abs2"),
        (("lunch", "pizza"), ("child", "Fred"), "eq"),
        (("color", "yellow"), ("name", "Peter"), "eq"),
        (("lunch", "grilled cheese"), ("child", "Meredith"), "left"),
        (("nationality", "german"), ("lunch", "spaghetti"), "eq"),
        (("book", "romance"), ("lunch", "stew"), "eq"),
        (("child", "Samantha"), ("nationality", "german"), "left"),
        (("name", "Alice"), ("nationality", "swede"), "eq"),
        (("name", "Arnold"), ("color", "green"), "eq"),
        (("child", "Meredith"), ("book", "biography"), "eq"),
        (("nationality", "norwegian"), ("color", "red"), "eq"),
        (("lunch", "spaghetti"), ("name", "Eric"), "eq"),
        (("nationality", "dane"), ("color", "yellow"), "less"),
        (("book", "mystery"), ("color", "red"), "left"),
    ]

    for cat, values in categories.items():
        cat_vars = [(cat, value) for value in values]
        for i in range(len(cat_vars)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(cat_vars)):
                constraints.append((cat_vars[i], cat_vars[j], "neq"))

    degree = {var: 0 for var in domains}
    for a, b, _ in constraints:
        degree[a] += 1
        degree[b] += 1

    arcs = []
    incoming = {var: [] for var in domains}
    for a, b, rel in constraints:
        idx = len(arcs)
        arcs.append((a, b, rel, True))
        incoming[b].append(idx)
        idx = len(arcs)
        arcs.append((b, a, rel, False))
        incoming[a].append(idx)

    def satisfies(a, b, rel):
        if rel == "eq":
            return a == b
        if rel == "neq":
            return a != b
        if rel == "abs2":
            return abs(a - b) == 2
        if rel == "left":
            return a + 1 == b
        if rel == "less":
            return a < b
        return False

    def revise(var, other, rel, doms, var_is_first):
        dom = doms[var]
        oth = doms[other]
        to_remove = []
        if var_is_first:
            for x in dom:
                if not any(satisfies(x, y, rel) for y in oth):
                    to_remove.append(x)
        else:
            for y in dom:
                if not any(satisfies(x, y, rel) for x in oth):
                    to_remove.append(y)
        if to_remove:
            for v in to_remove:
                dom.discard(v)
            return True
        return False

    def ac3(doms):
        queue = deque(range(len(arcs)))
        in_queue = set(range(len(arcs)))
        while queue:
            i = queue.popleft()
            in_queue.discard(i)
            var, other, rel, var_is_first = arcs[i]
            if not doms[var] or not doms[other]:
                return False
            if revise(var, other, rel, doms, var_is_first):
                if not doms[var]:
                    return False
                for j in incoming[var]:
                    if j not in in_queue:
                        queue.append(j)
                        in_queue.add(j)
        return True

    def is_solution(doms):
        if any(len(d) != 1 for d in doms.values()):
            return False
        for a, b, rel in constraints:
            va = next(iter(doms[a]))
            vb = next(iter(doms[b]))
            if not satisfies(va, vb, rel):
                return False
        return True

    def search(doms):
        if not ac3(doms):
            return None
        candidates = [var for var in doms if len(doms[var]) > 1]
        if not candidates:
            return doms if is_solution(doms) else None
        var = min(candidates, key=lambda v: (len(doms[v]), -degree[v]))
        for value in sorted(doms[var]):
            new_doms = {v: set(d) for v, d in doms.items()}
            new_doms[var] = {value}
            result = search(new_doms)
            if result is not None:
                return result
        return None

    solution = search(domains)
    if solution is None:
        return

    for h in houses:
        row = []
        for cat in output_order:
            chosen = None
            for value in categories[cat]:
                dom = solution[(cat, value)]
                if len(dom) == 1 and next(iter(dom)) == h:
                    chosen = value
                    break
            row.append(chosen)
        print(f"House {h}: {row[0]}, {row[1]}, {row[2]}, {row[3]}, {row[4]}, {row[5]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

def solve():

    genres = ['romance', 'mystery', 'fantasy', 'science fiction']
    heights = ['tall', 'very short', 'short', 'average']

    colors = ['red', 'green', 'yellow', 'white']

    def pos(perm, value):
        return perm.index(value)

    for name_perm in itertools.permutations(names):
        # Arnold not fourth

        for genre_perm in itertools.permutations(genres):
            # yellow in second? color later; but genre fantasy at yellow house unknown until color. Could skip some.
            # science fiction directly left of Eric: need name_perm pos Eric.
            try:
                sci_pos = genre_perm.index('science fiction')
                eric_pos = name_perm.index('Eric')
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if sci_pos + 1 != eric_pos: continue
            # Peter mystery
            if name_perm[genre_perm.index('mystery')] != 'Peter': continue
            for height_perm in itertools.permutations(heights):
                # desert very short? smoothie later, but height short/desert relation needs smoothie.
                for smoothie_perm in itertools.permutations(smoothies):
                    # desert = very short
                    if smoothie_perm[height_perm.index('very short')] != 'desert': continue
                    # cherry right of desert

                    # average = cherry

                    # dragonfruit = mystery

                        if color_perm[1] != 'yellow': continue

                        # fantasy = yellow
                        if genre_perm[color_perm.index('yellow')] != 'fantasy': continue
                        # dragonfruit next green
                        if abs(smoothie_perm.index('dragonfruit') - color_perm.index('green')) != 1: continue
                        # all constraints satisfied
                        for i in range(4):
                            print(f"House {i+1}: {name_perm[i]}, {genre_perm[i]}, {height_perm[i]}, {smoothie_perm[i]}, {color_perm[i]}")
                        return

if __name__ == '__main__':

```python
import itertools

def solve():
    names = ["Bob", "Carol", "Arnold", "Peter", "Eric", "Alice"]
    drinks = ["coffee", "boba tea", "root beer", "water", "tea", "milk"]

            if occ[1] != "teacher":
                continue
            if occ[5] == "lawyer":
                continue
            if name.index("Eric") != occ.index("nurse"):
                continue
            if abs(occ.index("lawyer") - occ.index("engineer")) != 1:
                continue

            nurse = occ.index("nurse")
            if nurse == 0:
                continue
            peter = name.index("Peter")
            if peter != nurse - 1:
                continue

            arnold = name.index("Arnold")
            if arnold == 0:
                continue
            root_beer = arnold - 1

            doctor = occ.index("doctor")
            if doctor == 5:
                continue
            boba = doctor + 1

            fixed = {}
            def put(pos, drink):
                if pos in fixed:
                    return fixed[pos] == drink
                fixed[pos] = drink
                return True

            if not put(nurse, "coffee"):
                continue
            if not put(peter, "tea"):
                continue
            if not put(root_beer, "root beer"):
                continue
            if not put(boba, "boba tea"):
                continue

            remaining = [i for i in range(6) if i not in fixed]
            water_choices = [i for i in remaining if i < root_beer]
            if not water_choices:
                continue

            drink_at = [""] * 6
            for pos, d in fixed.items():

            drink_at[water_choices[0]] = "water"
            for pos in remaining:
                if pos != water_choices[0]:
                    drink_at[pos] = "milk"

            if len(set(drink_at)) != 6:
                continue

            for i in range(6):
                print(f"House {i + 1}: {name[i]}, {drink_at[i]}, {occ[i]}")
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
```

import sys
from collections import deque

names = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Peter", "Bob", "Alice", "Carol"]
music = ["jazz", "country", "pop", "classical", "rock", "hip hop"]
styles = ["mediterranean", "modern", "colonial", "ranch", "victorian", "craftsman"]
sports = ["tennis", "baseball", "soccer", "volleyball", "swimming", "basketball"]
books = ["science fiction", "historical fiction", "mystery", "biography", "fantasy", "romance"]

categories = {
    "name": names,
    "music": music,
    "style": styles,
    "sport": sports,
    "book": books,
}

variables = [(cat, val) for cat, vals in categories.items() for val in vals]
domains = {var: set(range(6)) for var in variables}
domains[("sport", "basketball")] = {3}

out_arcs = {var: [] for var in variables}
in_arcs = {var: [] for var in variables}
binary_constraints = []

def add_constraint(a, b, rel):
    binary_constraints.append((a, b, rel))
    out_arcs[a].append((b, rel))
    in_arcs[b].append((a, rel))
    rev = lambda x, y, rel=rel: rel(y, x)
    out_arcs[b].append((a, rev))
    in_arcs[a].append((b, rev))

eq = lambda x, y: x == y
neq = lambda x, y: x != y
lt = lambda x, y: x < y
directly_left = lambda x, y: x + 1 == y
one_between = lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 2
two_between = lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 2

for cat, vals in categories.items():
    for i in range(len(vals)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(vals)):
            add_constraint((cat, vals[i]), (cat, vals[j]), neq)

add_constraint(("sport", "baseball"), ("name", "Arnold"), eq)
add_constraint(("name", "Alice"), ("style", "colonial"), lt)
add_constraint(("music", "country"), ("music", "hip hop"), directly_left)
add_constraint(("name", "Peter"), ("style", "victorian"), eq)
add_constraint(("name", "Peter"), ("book", "fantasy"), eq)
add_constraint(("sport", "baseball"), ("book", "romance"), eq)
add_constraint(("music", "hip hop"), ("book", "biography"), lt)
add_constraint(("style", "ranch"), ("book", "romance"), lt)
add_constraint(("name", "Bob"), ("sport", "swimming"), eq)
add_constraint(("book", "romance"), ("book", "mystery"), lt)
add_constraint(("name", "Bob"), ("music", "jazz"), eq)
add_constraint(("style", "craftsman"), ("book", "mystery"), eq)
add_constraint(("name", "Peter"), ("sport", "basketball"), lt)
add_constraint(("style", "mediterranean"), ("sport", "volleyball"), lt)
add_constraint(("name", "Alice"), ("style", "mediterranean"), eq)
add_constraint(("book", "historical fiction"), ("style", "colonial"), directly_left)
add_constraint(("name", "Carol"), ("music", "pop"), directly_left)
add_constraint(("music", "pop"), ("music", "classical"), one_between)
add_constraint(("sport", "tennis"), ("name", "Alice"), two_between)

def ac3(dom):
    queue = deque()
    for x in variables:
        for y, rel in out_arcs[x]:
            queue.append((x, y, rel))
    while queue:
        x, y, rel = queue.popleft()
        if not dom[x] or not dom[y]:
            return False
        remove = []
        for xv in dom[x]:
            supported = False
            for yv in dom[y]:
                if rel(xv, yv):
                    supported = True
                    break
            if not supported:
                remove.append(xv)
        for xv in remove:
            dom[x].remove(xv)
        if remove:
            if not dom[x]:
                return False
            for z, rel_zx in in_arcs[x]:
                queue.append((z, x, rel_zx))
    return True

def solve(dom):
    if not ac3(dom):
        return None
    unassigned = [var for var in variables if len(dom[var]) > 1]
    if not unassigned:
        for a, b, rel in binary_constraints:
            if not rel(next(iter(dom[a])), next(iter(dom[b]))):
                return None
        return dom
    var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(dom[v]), -len(out_arcs[v])))
    for value in sorted(dom[var]):
        new_dom = {v: set(dom[v]) for v in variables}
        new_dom[var] = {value}
        result = solve(new_dom)
        if result is not None:
            return result
    return None

solution = solve(domains)
if solution is None:
    sys.exit(1)

grid = {cat: [None] * 6 for cat in categories}
for var, pos_set in solution.items():
    pos = next(iter(pos_set))
    cat, val = var
    grid[cat][pos] = val

for h in range(6):
    print(
        f"House {h + 1}: {grid['name'][h]}, {grid['music'][h]}, "
        f"{grid['style'][h]}, {grid['sport'][h]}, {grid['book'][h]}"
    )
```

class UnionFind:
    def __init__(self, items):
        self.parent = {item:item for item in items}
    def find(self, x):
        while self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.parent[self.parent[x]]
            x = self.parent[x]
        return x
    def union(self,a,b):
        ra,rb=self.find(a),self.find(b)
        if ra!=rb:
            self.parent[rb]=ra

def all_diff_support(vars, domains, v, x):
    # assign v=x, for other vars choose distinct positions from domains excluding x
    others = [u for u in vars if u != v]
    # order by domain size
    def rec(idx, used):
       if idx==len(others): return True
       u=others[idx]
       for p in domains[u]:
          if p not in used:
             if rec(idx+1, used|{p}): return True
       return False
    return rec(0, {x})
```

                        if new != old:
                            domains[v] = new
                            changed=True
                            if not new: return False
    return changed
